recipes.name: Linked RGB sockets
recipes.requirements: One item with linked red, green and blue sockets. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Six sockets
recipes.requirements: One item with six sockets. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Six linked sockets

recipes.name: Six explicit affixes
recipes.requirements: One rare item with six explicit affixes. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Two explicit affixes
recipes.requirements: One rare item with exactly two explicit affixes. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Two matching rare names
recipes.requirements: Two identified rare items with the same generated name. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Three matching rare names
recipes.requirements: Three identified rare items with the same generated name. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Two matching rare names, quality
recipes.requirements: Two identified rare items with the same name, each 20% quality. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Three matching rare names, quality
recipes.requirements: Three identified rare items with the same name, each 20% quality. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Normal, magic and rare
recipes.requirements: Three items with the same base type, one of each rarity. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Normal, magic and rare, unidentified
recipes.requirements: Same base type; magic and rare items unidentified. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Normal, magic and rare, quality
recipes.requirements: Same base type; all three items 20% quality. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Normal, magic and rare, quality and unidentified
recipes.requirements: Same base type; all 20% quality; magic and rare unidentified. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Normal, magic, rare and unique
recipes.requirements: Four items with the same base type, one of each rarity. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Armour quality
recipes.requirements: One normal armour item at 20% quality, or armour with total quality at least 40%. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Weapon quality
recipes.requirements: One normal weapon at 20% quality, or weapons with total quality at least 40%. Use one recipe batch per calculation; overlapping recipes do not stack.

recipes.name: Gem quality

recipes.name: Chance rare set: normal
recipes.requirements: Complete rare equipment set: body, helmet, gloves, boots, belt, amulet, two rings and weapon slots. Lowest item level 1 to 59.

recipes.name: Chance rare set: unid
recipes.requirements: Complete rare equipment set: body, helmet, gloves, boots, belt, amulet, two rings and weapon slots. Lowest item level 1 to 59. All items unidentified.

recipes.name: Chance rare set: quality
recipes.requirements: Complete rare equipment set: body, helmet, gloves, boots, belt, amulet, two rings and weapon slots. Lowest item level 1 to 59. All applicable items at 20% quality.

recipes.name: Chance rare set: both
recipes.requirements: Complete rare equipment set: body, helmet, gloves, boots, belt, amulet, two rings and weapon slots. Lowest item level 1 to 59. All items unidentified and all applicable items at 20% quality.

recipes.name: Chaos rare set: unid
recipes.requirements: Complete rare equipment set: body, helmet, gloves, boots, belt, amulet, two rings and weapon slots. Lowest item level 60 to 74. All items unidentified.

recipes.name: Chaos rare set: quality
recipes.requirements: Complete rare equipment set: body, helmet, gloves, boots, belt, amulet, two rings and weapon slots. Lowest item level 60 to 74. All applicable items at 20% quality.

recipes.name: Chaos rare set: both
recipes.requirements: Complete rare equipment set: body, helmet, gloves, boots, belt, amulet, two rings and weapon slots. Lowest item level 60 to 74. All items unidentified and all applicable items at 20% quality.

recipes.name: Regal rare set: normal

recipes.name: Regal rare set: unid
recipes.requirements: Complete rare equipment set: body, helmet, gloves, boots, belt, amulet, two rings and weapon slots. Lowest item level 75 or higher. All items unidentified.

recipes.name: Regal rare set: quality

recipes.name: Influenced rare set: identified
recipes.requirements: Complete rare equipment set with every item sharing one influence. Updated for 3.28: rewards Exalted Orbs.

recipes.name: Influenced rare set: unidentified
recipes.requirements: Complete rare equipment set with every item sharing one influence. All items unidentified. Updated for 3.28: rewards Exalted Orbs.

recipes.name: Essence upgrade
recipes.requirements: Three matching essences yield one of the next tier. Deafening and corrupted essences cannot be upgraded. Matching currency IDs present in the snapshot are scanned automatically.

recipes.name: Oil upgrade
recipes.requirements: Three matching oils yield one of the next tier. Special oils and the top tier are excluded. Oil prices are not present in the currency-only snapshot used here, so this rule is documented but not scanned.

recipes.name: Currency shards and scroll fragments
recipes.requirements: Stack conversion is automatic, not a vendor trade. Five scroll fragments make a Wisdom Scroll; most currency shards combine at twenty. These are not scanned without a quoted shard market.

recipes.name: Identified item shards
recipes.requirements: Alteration and Alchemy shard rewards depend on the actual modifiers. Check the sell window; no fixed return is assumed.

recipes.name: Unidentified item shards
recipes.requirements: Unidentified magic and rare equipment yields Transmutation shards. Item type and competing recipes affect the actual sell-window result.

recipes.name: Faustus and Heist targets
recipes.requirements: Faustus runs the player currency market. He also buys Heist targets for an item-specific Rogue Marker value. Neither supplies a universal additional fixed exchange rate.

recipes.name: Divine Vessels
recipes.requirements: Five normal flasks and one Divine Orb produce five Divine Vessels. Item and output prices are required; vessels are outside the currency-only graph.

recipes.name: Book of Reform
recipes.requirements: A Book of Reform sells for twenty Orbs of Regret. The quest item cannot be purchased on the currency market.

recipes.name: Vaults of Atziri
recipes.requirements: Selling the Vaults of Atziri unique map returns a Chaos Orb. Map acquisition cost is outside this feed.

recipes.name: Catalyst reroll
recipes.requirements: Three matching catalysts yield a random catalyst. Quality jewellery also yields a random catalyst; no deterministic profit is claimed.

recipes.name: Scarab reroll
recipes.requirements: Three scarabs yield a random scarab of a different type. Not a guaranteed conversion.

recipes.name: Tattoo reroll
recipes.requirements: Three tattoos of the same tribe yield one random tattoo from that tribe.

recipes.name: Cartographer chisels
recipes.requirements: All Chisel vendor recipes removed in 3.28.

recipes.name: Quality currency purchases
recipes.requirements: Quality-currency-priced purchases and vendor Bauble purchases removed in 3.25. Selling quality currency and quality-item recipes are separate.
